CASE_CLAIM.json: write-once fixed row/source/actual audit+review+root proofs, before all case setup
MATRIX_CLAIM.json: fixed32 roster/release/prerequisite proofs; resume identity check before any new epoch
SETUP.json: spec_driver_only, public Contract, version, source pins, active dt/damping/inertia/initial qpos/qvel/ctrl; private fields never passed to actor
TERMINAL.json: case status/error/roster/source/admission proofs/created and started epoch/actual steps and rows/counts/budget/pending; recording is separate from independent acceptance
acceptance: independent RAW, service/command identity, exact clocks, public causal sequence and immutable-origin audit required; actor or exit0 alone insufficient
commands.json: all actual accepted reservations, including original external B and any pending A/C

independent_samples.csv.native_clock: native_time_s is actual data.time, sim_ns=round(actual data.time*1e9) checked against fixed grid
independent_samples.csv.phase: post service effects, pre controller requests and pre native step

method: row.method; four exact pinned registry classes
partial_exception: partial files/row counts preserved plus EXCEPTION.json and NATIVE_DEV_RESULT.json; no complete-record status
public_decisions.json: all paid decisions including declined/discarded decisions and budget/model/input evidence
public_final_snapshot.json: entire pinned controller snapshot, ledger history, cumulative counts and original-event facts
raw_verdict.json: unchanged copied referee's output only after execution, never passed to actor
